replies.author: flashcard5
replies.text:
ok so last reply that seems to have fixed it for me, sharing before "closing" this thread, and to give a solution for others : what worked for me is to go to settings > app > action notch > disable.

that way, the banking app doesnt detect it anymore and can be launched;

not optimal, but the other options didnt work in my case because either action notch couldnt be properly launched if not in owner profile (due to accessibility needs), or banking apps didnt work because it thinks its in rooted device. hope that helps

so i guess there are several ways to solve for that, it depends on the checks each apps do...
